8123_research: The complete official original and primary PLO1704 establish the reservation and all dependent protection/naming provisions ended by express whole revocation on1958-08-05. Primary pages correct both the contaminated frozen original inventory and the editorialAug4date. PR2416 supplies an earlier name amendment, not first cessation; the full1950 report supplies material operational abandonment evidence, not a legal termination. Original terms contain no lapse/completion mechanism and bounded later searches locate no revival or surviving EO-dependent norm.
8123_earlier: The original has no sunset, deadline, completed assignment or cessation condition. PR2416 changed only the refuge name on1940-07-25 and is recorded as amendment, not an ending. The1950 report documents damaged structures, water loss, virtual abandonment and removal of signs under verbal instructions; it does not cancel the refuge, terminate an easement, relinquish all federal control or supply an earlier legal ending. No earlier named cessation was located in bounded number/name searches.
8123_scope: The complete original reserves320acres in N1/2section13,T143N,R78W,Fifth Principal Meridian. PLO1704 expressly revokes EO8123 and repeats the identical Lake Moraine tract. It has no partial limiter, deferred effective date or continuing provision. Its signature date is1958-08-05; NARA editorial1958-08-04 is contradicted by the actual center-column signature. FilingAug8/publicationAug9 are separate dates.
8123_independent: The complete3paragraph inventory includes reservation, wildlife/entry prohibition with regulatory exception, and naming. Prohibition and regulation permission apply within this refuge; neither is an independent continuing command after whole revocation. PR2416 renaming does not create a new reservation or save EO8123 authority. No independent EO8123 command remains.
8123_savings: Original subject-to-valid-rights language protects preexisting rights rather than granting surviving EO authority. PLO1704 contains no savings and states the lands are non-public lands, without a restoration/opening delay. Preexisting private rights, historical naming and independently authorized acts are not continuing EO effects under TC04/TC08. Bounded later checks found no revival or current EO-dependent residual.
